2. In template engines like Tempita, Jinja2 (in some configurations), and similar tools, the use of `eval()` to evaluate template expressions is a core part of the design. The template language typically allows expressions like `{{ 1 + 2 }}` or `{{ items[0] }}` which need to be evaluated as Python expressions.
